analysis.reason: 2거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 53.6 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 히스토그램 개선 미확인. 거래량비 0.36으로 움직임 위축. 5일 저가 1.32가 20일 저가 1.31 상회하며 Higher Low 패턴 초입 확인. 변동성 ATR 4.78% 대비 손절폭 1.3*ATR($0.09) 설정 시 진입가 $1.36 대비 손절가 $1.27, 목표가 $1.54 (손익비 1.5 이상) 설정 가능. 그러나 추세 전환 확신 부족으로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the second consecutive session. RSI at 53.6 consolidating in the neutral zone, MACD histogram improvement unconfirmed. Volume ratio at 0.36 indicates subdued activity. The 5-day low of $1.32 is above the 20-day low of $1.31, confirming the initial stage of a Higher Low pattern. Considering the volatility (ATR 4.78%), a stop loss of 1.3*ATR ($0.09) from an entry of $1.36 would set the stop at $1.27 and target at $1.54 (risk-reward ratio >= 1.5). However, conviction for a trend reversal is lacking, hence the cautious stance.
